overview: Lexical, syntax, semantic analysis, intermediate code, optimization, code generation; kaunsa error kis phase me.
coreConcept: Front-end (analysis) machine independent; back-end (synthesis) target dependent.
hinglishExplanation: Har error type kisi ek phase me pakda jaata hai: illegal token (lexical), grammar galat (syntax), type mismatch/undeclared (semantic). Symbol table saare phases me use hoti hai.
formalDefinition: Front-end (analysis) machine independent; back-end (synthesis) target dependent.
importantProperties: Phases: lexical -> syntax -> semantic -> ICG -> optimization -> code generation.
Lexical: tokens; syntax: grammar; semantic: type checking.
Front-end target independent; back-end target dependent.
Symbol table sabhi phases access karte hain.
CFG lexical aur syntax dono specify kar sakta hai.
commonPitfalls: Undeclared var ko syntax error maan lena.
